wearable_checks.title: Wearable height
wearable_checks.method: Product external envelope; orientation-specific, not chest conformity

wearable_checks.title: Complete wearable mass
wearable_checks.message: Include PCB, components, battery, enclosure, adhesive and electrodes; confirm completeness.

wearable_checks.title: Battery runtime
wearable_checks.method: Usable mAh / average battery-side mA; requires duty cycle, conversion loss and aging evidence
wearable_checks.message: Supply battery_capacity_mah, average_current_ma, usable_capacity_fraction before evaluating.

wearable_checks.title: Input-referred signal/noise budget
wearable_checks.method: 20 log10(signal RMS / noise RMS), same input reference and bandwidth; not diagnostic sensitivity
wearable_checks.message: Supply minimum_signal_uv_rms, input_noise_uv_rms, noise_bandwidth_hz, required_snr_db before evaluating.

sources.title: TI ADS1292R layout guidance
sources.requirement: Review analog return paths, decoupling and digital-current isolation. Spacing alone does not validate noise performance.

sources.title: FDA biocompatibility assessment
sources.requirement: Assess contact materials and contact duration for the intended intact-skin use. No biological test result is inferred from CAD.

sources.title: KiCad DRC and ERC tooling
sources.requirement: Validate routing/manufacturing rules with DRC and schematic electrical rules with ERC. Neither is a medical-safety certification.

brief:
Single-lead ECG chest patch.

Sticks to the patient's chest with adhesive, worn continuously for up to 14
days — showers included, never removed. Two Ag/AgCl electrodes pick up the
biopotential; the patch records continuously and streams to the patient's phone
over BLE a few times a day.

Sealed enclosure, roughly 100 x 40 x 7 mm interior. Rechargeable — charged from
a cradle through a gasketed contact window. Must be thin enough to wear under a
shirt without catching. Shipping to a hospital pilot; it will go through a
regulatory review we do not control.
